title: Unfolded size with bounded fanout
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit whose gates have pairwise distinct input vertices, whose NOT gates each have exactly one input, and whose gates each have at most two input vertices. Suppose every non-input vertex is used as an input by at most one gate. Then the size of the tree obtained by unfolding $C$ is at most $3$ times the number of gates of $C$, plus $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate has pairwise distinct input vertices
Every NOT gate has exactly one input
Every gate has at most two input vertices
Each vertex with index at least the number of input variables has fanout at most one
